verdict.rationale: v0 can connect a project to GitHub and push its code directly to your own repository, where you can work on branches, run CI, and merge pull requests. The API also lists export capabilities for backup and migration, and v0 describes its output as real code for full-stack apps, so you own a portable copy of the source. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running or hosting the exported app outside Vercel (all deployment docs are Vercel-centric), a direct download/zip export path, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
